note: Preserved prior proposals for next Design Version, subject to its design/exam. Not coverage or play evidence.

leaves.experience: The observer sees types at configured spacing/clearance with meaningful contents; tick-zero clamped claims are not falsely called aged mid-cycle.
leaves.scenario: Observer at normal colony zoom, using close view only for inspect/UI: Three fresh home seeds and enemy/quest control; actual start/used rects/count before prep. Generate normally, survey farmstead/claimed field/hedge homestead contents.
false_pass: Direct generation on cleared pad passes normal entry or impossible claim age.
leaves.red: A build where direct generation on cleared pad passes normal entry or impossible claim age.
leaves.owner_part: yes: home maps contain spaced legible ruins
leaves.oracle_proposed: sc_ruins: The observer sees types at configured spacing/clearance with meaningful contents; tick-zero clamped claims are not falsely called aged mid-cycle. Control: No step ruins off/non-home and overlap is rejected.
leaves.tier_reason: Actual engine AI/jobs, rendering/audio or saved identity behavior is required; source or direct helper call alone cannot establish this play result.

leaves.experience: The observer completes plans to RM_WindVaporators to RM_WindVaporator to actual RM_FogWater via powered spawner, with no drying scar.
leaves.scenario: Observer at normal colony zoom, using close view only for inspect/UI: Unfinished research, Electricity prerequisite, actual farmstead plans, build materials and zero water. Recover/apply techprint, complete real research/build/power/collect; reload spawner clock.
false_pass: Correct defs pass an unusable learn/build/produce chain.
leaves.red: A build where correct defs pass an unusable learn/build/produce chain.
leaves.oracle_proposed: sc_vaporator: The observer completes plans to RM_WindVaporators to RM_WindVaporator to actual RM_FogWater via powered spawner, with no drying scar. Control: No research/build bypass or unpowered/capped water.
leaves.tier_reason: Actual engine AI/jobs, rendering/audio or saved identity behavior is required; source or direct helper call alone cannot establish this play result.

leaves.experience: The observer sees eligible camp defend, assault when hostile, resume defend at peace. Base empty eligibility legitimately gives none but cannot accept campaign positive behavior.
leaves.scenario: Observer at normal colony zoom, using close view only for inspect/UI: Campaign eligible scavenger faction/nonhostile; separately base empty list; no farmer faction. Normal camp generation, needs/defend, hostility/assault, peace/return, reload lord.
false_pass: Empty base list proves a positive faction transition.
leaves.red: A build where empty base list proves a positive faction transition.
leaves.oracle_proposed: sc_camps: The observer sees eligible camp defend, assault when hostile, resume defend at peace. Base empty eligibility legitimately gives none but cannot accept campaign positive behavior. Control: No camp in controls; farmer camps absent.
leaves.tier_reason: Actual engine campaign faction/lord behavior is required; source or direct helper call alone cannot establish this play result.

leaves.experience: The observer sees forbidden refuse and its believers react negatively to another eligible caller, last-rite require active enemies, and venerated permit without that enemy condition with positive believer response; eligible meme choices follow their loaded defs.
leaves.scenario: Observer at normal colony zoom, using close view only for inspect/UI: Forbidden/last-rite/venerated ideoligions, eligible/ineligible memes, known participant thoughts/history. Use real belief/ritual UI for each; compare start gates and actual thoughts/history after call.
false_pass: Three resolved precepts pass identical play.
leaves.red: A build where three resolved precepts pass identical play.
leaves.oracle_proposed: sc_pyre_beliefs: The observer sees forbidden refuse and its believers react negatively to another eligible caller, last-rite require active enemies, and venerated permit without that enemy condition with positive believer response; eligible meme choices follow their loaded defs. Control: Ineligible/disabled start refused readably; consequence difference follows precept data.
leaves.tier_reason: Actual engine AI/jobs, rendering/audio or saved identity behavior is required; source or direct helper call alone cannot establish this play result.

leaves.experience: The player sees completed ritual cause table-defined fire/herd/rage, history and honest thin-fire message. Base positive responding herd required; raging arrivals remain dangerous.
leaves.scenario: Observer at normal colony zoom, using close view only for inspect/UI: Real ritual gates, flammable crop, outcome tables, base marked kind and valid edge; thin/adequate fire patterns. Complete actual ritual for each outcome tier with controlled outcome RNG; follow ignition, edge arrivals, rage, stamping and aftermath.
false_pass: Separate debug ignition/spawn passes a ritual whose normal outcome never runs.
leaves.red: A build where separate debug ignition/spawn passes a ritual whose normal outcome never runs.
leaves.owner_part: yes: completed rituals ignite fields and call a real herd
leaves.oracle_proposed: sc_pyre_ritual: The player sees completed ritual cause table-defined fire/herd/rage, history and honest thin-fire message. Base positive responding herd required; raging arrivals remain dangerous. Control: Disabled/ineligible cannot start, thin message truthful and separate Ignite/CallHerd cannot accept completion.
leaves.tier_reason: Actual engine AI/jobs, rendering/audio or saved identity behavior is required; source or direct helper call alone cannot establish this play result.

scenes.restore: Before any preflight mutation call designer_stage.py scene-begin with unique recovery save and digest. Capture actual settings file/static values, storyteller/queued incidents, current world/map/save, weather/lock, ticks, actor health/jobs, terrain/roofs/zones/pollution and fixture/bystander IDs. On success, exception or interrupt restore recovery save plus settings and verify digest/identity census; delete only recorded fixture IDs. DEFAULTS, Clear weather and broad pad/wildlife sweeps are insufficient. Call scene-end only after verified restore; owner_review calls scene-hold with named save/end condition, then later verifies restore. Failed recovery stays open and blocks further runs.
scenes.time_budget: At most 6000 observed ticks per declared predicate/job phase, with finite phase count previewed before run, after asserted precondition; compress declared long timers and test original production boundaries offline. No long populated-colony clock warp. Missing preconditions are UNMEASURED.
